name: O-Kagachi
description: A dragon-turtle kami destroyed by the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit.

description_citations.text: "Toshiro Umezawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lord Takeshi Konda steals O-Kagachi's heart in 3207 AR, enraging it and starting the Kami War.
timeline.quote: Lord Takeshi Konda stole the great kami's "heart" and a portion of its power

citation.text: "God", section "O-Kagachi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi tears the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos in two, and Hidetsugu asks Toshi to transport him to the oni's honden.
timeline.quote: the oni overlord was almost effortlessly torn in two by O-Kagachi

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The theft of O-Kagachi's scion starts the Kami War.
timeline.quote: It was because the theft of O-Kagachi's scion, that the Kami War began.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yosei is ripped apart in battle against O-Kagachi but survives to help Eiganjo's refugees.
timeline.quote: He was ripped-apart in the battle against O-Kagachi, but survived and helped the Eiganjoan refugees in the battle against the hordes of the Myojin of Infinite Rage.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Dragon spirits". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Damage from the Apocalypse Chime weakens the veil, letting Konda pull an aspect of O-Kagachi through it and begin the Kami War.
timeline.quote: thus beginning the Kami War .

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the war's twentieth year Michiko Konda frees the scion Kyodai and defeats O-Kagachi and Konda; O-Kagachi's death merges the two realms.
timeline.quote: The death of O-Kagachi caused the barrier between the two realms to break down

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takeshi Konda steals the essence of a kami from the Kakuriyo on the night of Michiko's birth, imprisoning it and awakening O-Kagachi, beginning the Kami War.
timeline.quote: this act awoke the prisoner's parent, beginning the Kami War .

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai defeat Konda and O-Kagachi and become guardians of the barrier between realms.
timeline.quote: defeated Konda and O-Kagachi and claimed themselves the guardians of the barrier between the Utsushiyo and the Kakuriyo.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko shatters the disk, freeing the Taken One, who becomes Kyodai; they merge into the Sisters and destroy O-Kagachi.
timeline.quote: together they destroyed O-Kagachi

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lord Konda raids the Spirit World and tears out O-Kagachi's heart, casting it as a stone disk.
timeline.quote: he tore out O-Kagachi's "heart," its divinity

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Enraged, O-Kagachi moves the other kami to strike the mortal world, beginning the Kami War.
timeline.quote: thus the Kami War began

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the twentieth year, O-Kagachi first manifests, devouring three thousand warriors and defeating the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
timeline.quote: It also defeated Hidetsugu's master, the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos easily.

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "First Manifestation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi stabs Hidetsugu through the remaining eye; the All-Consuming and O-Kagachi clash and Hidetsugu is changed.
timeline.quote: Hidetsugu prevailed in the end, but Toshi used his victory gesture to stab him through the remaining eye from a shadow cast by Kiku's body.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko touches the disk, releasing Kyodai; they merge into the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit, destroy O-Kagachi and take his place.
timeline.quote: Together, they destroyed O-Kagachi and took his place.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Warriors turn to face O-Kagachi and die of awe.
timeline.quote: The clashing warriors turned to face O-Kagachi, the greatest kami, and their sigh of awe was their last breath.

citation.text: Final Judgment (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi attacks Eiganjo and the refugees run into the akki army.
timeline.quote: then O-Kagachi attacks Eiganjo.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu's forces kill Keiga; at Eiganjo O-Kagachi bites Yosei in half and Takeno dies protecting Konda; Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken, making O-Kagachi disappear.
timeline.quote: Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken and teleports out, making O-Kagachi disappear.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi descends on Eiganjo Castle, rips Yosei in half and ruins the castle.
timeline.quote: One of O-Kagachi's heads caught Yosei in its jaws and ripped him in half

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Attack on Eiganjo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi senses the Taken One's absence and retreats, leaving Konda's kingdom in ruins.
timeline.quote: leaving in its wake the ruins of Konda's kingdom

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Attack on Eiganjo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi appears; the Oni of Chaos flees, breaking Hidetsugu's spirit, and Toshi mercy kills Marrow-Gnawer.
timeline.quote: Toshi mercy kills Marrow-Gnawer

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Konda arrives at Jukai and the Taken One summons O-Kagachi; Toshi teleports the Taken One through Night's Reach's realm against her command.
timeline.quote: he teleports the Taken One through Night's Reach's realm

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko frees the spirit in the Taken One, who is named Kyodai; O-Kagachi manifests all eight heads.
timeline.quote: Toshi suggests " Kyodai ", meaning "sibling"

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai merge and defeat O-Kagachi, biting off his last heads; Konda is turned to stone and shattered.
timeline.quote: Konda then shows up but is quickly turned to stone and shattered

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Toshi release the Taken One in Jukai Forest; she takes the name Kyodai and binds her power with Michiko.
timeline.quote: took the name Kyodai and bound her power with Princess Michiko Konda

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai and Michiko immobilize and defeat O-Kagachi, biting off its remaining heads.
timeline.quote: bit off O-Kagachi's remaining heads, then cast the limp body aside

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi's death breaks down the barrier, merging the spirit and mortal realms.
timeline.quote: The death of O-Kagachi caused the barrier between the two realms to break down

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At O-Kagachi's behest the Kami War begins to regain That Which Was Taken.
timeline.quote: At his behest the Kami War began to regain That Which Was Taken.

citation.text: O-Kagachi, Vengeful Kami (Commander 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi tears the All-Consuming in half; it flees and disappears.
timeline.quote: O-Kagachi almost effortlessly tore him in half and swallowed the torn part

citation.text: "All-Consuming Oni of Chaos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi manifests and attacks Eiganjo to recover his stolen offspring, reducing it to rubble.
timeline.quote: Eiganjo was reduced to rubble by the wrath of The Great Serpent.

citation.text: "Eiganjo", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Konda performs an arcane ritual with moonfolk and wizard allies and kidnaps O-Kagachi's child, imprisoning it in a stone disk.
timeline.quote: Konda tore the god-child out of the spirit realm and brought it into the physical world

citation.text: "Kami War", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the twentieth year Michiko Konda, aided by Toshiro Umezawa, frees the scion Kyodai and defeats O-Kagachi and Lord Konda, ending the war.
timeline.quote: managed to free the kidnapped scion

citation.text: "Kami War", section "Conflict". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The kidnapping outrages O-Kagachi, igniting an ire that claims countless lives.
timeline.quote: This outraged the great O-Kagachi, kami of all things, igniting an ire that would claim countless lives.

citation.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: What remained of the academy is destroyed in the battle between O-Kagachi and the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
timeline.quote: Whatever was left of the Academy was further destroyed in the battle between O-Kagachi and the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos .

citation.text: "Minamo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When O-Kagachi attacks Eiganjo, Takeno shields Konda from a rock and is impaled.
timeline.quote: Takeno leaped in the way of a huge flying sliver of rock

citation.text: "Munetsugu Takeno", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takeno is recreated as a spirit, and ceases to exist when O-Kagachi is destroyed by the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit.
timeline.quote: ceased to exist when O-Kagachi was destroyed

citation.text: "Munetsugu Takeno", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Kami War, the Myojin discovers she can use the wavering planar barriers to travel the multiverse.
timeline.quote: The Myojin of Night's Reach discovered she could use this to travel across the multiverse

citation.text: "Myojin of Night's Reach", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pearl-Ear witnesses O-Kagachi's appearance, the climactic battle and the Daimyo's fate.
timeline.quote: She witnessed the climactic battle above the boughs, as well as the Daimyo's ultimate fate.

citation.text: "Pearl-Ear", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kumano is visited by kami seeking the reason for O-Kagachi's rage; he fights Kakkazan and resolves to leave and find who lied.
timeline.quote: After the yamabushi's fight with Kakkazan , Great Kami of the Mountain Fire, Kumano decided it was time to leave his plateau

citation.text: "Ryusaki Kumano", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Konda performed a sacrilegious ritual breaking the barrier between mortal and spirit worlds and imprisoned a major spirit, gaining immortality.
timeline.quote: he broke the barrier between the mortal and spirit worlds

citation.text: "Takeshi Konda", section "Konda's Crime". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the climax of the war Konda and O-Kagachi were struck down by their daughters Michiko and Kyodai.
timeline.quote: Konda and O-Kagachi were struck down by their daughters

citation.text: "Takeshi Konda", section "The Reckoning". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
